matchupOfTheWeek.title: Rush Offense vs. Run Defense
matchupOfTheWeek.description: Our rush offense grades in the 65th percentile against a unit that grades 10th — the widest real statistical edge on the board this week.

previewTake: Buffalo's offense ranks second in EPA—they're elite, full stop—but here's where we get to play the hand we've been dealt: their defense is 25th, and we have the widest statistical edge on the board this week in the one area we can actually exploit it. Our rush offense grades in the 65th percentile against their run defense at 10th; that's a chasm, and it's precisely where we need to live for four quarters. The Bills have been the marginally better team in the recent ledger (they're +0.14 in net EPA over their last three versus our -0.11), but we've won in Buffalo twice in the last three meetings, and that's not nothing—especially when you're walking into a game where your path to victory is as clear as the rushing lanes we should be finding. This is a winnable game if we can keep their offense off the field and pound the rock. The bad news? Their second-ranked EPA tells you they're going to score. The good news? We know exactly where to attack.
